task: The team lead asks for a volunteer. Offer to do it and give a day.
say: Who can update the documentation?
zh: 组长找人主动承担一项任务。自告奋勇，并给出完成日期。对方说：谁能更新一下文档？
example: I can do that. I'll have it updated by Friday.

task: The chair gives you an action. Accept it and say when you'll do it.
say: Okay, Raj, can you send out the meeting notes?
zh: 主持人给你分配了一项任务。接受，并说什么时候完成。对方说：好，Raj，你能把会议纪要发出去吗？
example: Sure, I'll send them out this afternoon.

task: Someone says a job needs doing, but nobody is named. Ask who owns it and offer to help.
say: Someone needs to tell the users about the outage.
zh: 有人说某件事需要做，但没指定人。问谁负责，并主动提出帮忙。对方说：得有人通知用户停机的事。
example: Who's going to send that email? I'm happy to do it if no one else is.

task: The meeting is ending and the chair asks if there's anything else. You have nothing more. Close politely.
say: I think that's everything. Anything else from anyone?
zh: 会议快结束了，主持人问还有没有别的事。你没有了。礼貌地收尾。对方说：我想就这些了。大家还有别的吗？
example: Nothing else from me. Thanks, everyone, that was really useful.

task: A client asks you to send them a document link. Promise to email it straight after the call.
say: Could you send me the link to that document?
zh: 客户让你把文档链接发给他。答应会后马上发邮件。对方说：你能把那个文档的链接发给我吗？
example: Of course. I'll pop it in an email straight after this call.

task: The project manager suggests another meeting. Agree and suggest a time.
say: Shall we catch up again next week?
zh: 项目经理提议再开一次会。表示同意并建议一个时间。对方说：我们下周再碰一次吧？
example: Yes, sounds good. Does the same time next Tuesday work for everyone?

task: At the end of a meeting, the chair asks you to sum up what was agreed. Give the decisions, dates and owners.
say: Raj, could you quickly sum up what we agreed?
zh: 会议结束时，主持人请你总结一下达成的共识。说出决定、日期和负责人。对方说：Raj，你能简单总结一下我们定了什么吗？
example: Sure. We're going with option B, go-live is the 15th, and Aroha will confirm the test plan by Friday.

task: The meeting is going off track on a side topic. Suggest parking it and dealing with it later.
say: And the naming standard really needs a rethink too.
zh: 会议在一个次要话题上越扯越远。建议先放一放，以后再讨论。对方说：还有命名规范也真的需要重新考虑一下。
example: Good point, but shall we park that for now? We could set up a separate session on naming next week.

task: Your manager gives you an action without a deadline. Accept it and check when it's needed.
say: Can you look at those alerts that keep firing?
zh: 经理给你分配了任务但没说截止时间。接下任务，并确认什么时候要。对方说：你能看看那些一直在报的告警吗？
example: Yep, I'll take that. Is end of the week okay, or do you need it sooner?

task: Everyone agrees something should be done, but no owner or date is set. Make sure it gets an owner.
say: Great, so we'll fix the backup alerts.
zh: 大家都同意要做某件事，但没定负责人和日期。确保有人负责。对方说：好，那我们把备份告警修好。
example: Just so nothing gets missed, who's taking that one? And by when?

task: Time is almost up but there are still several agenda items. Suggest what to do.
say: We've still got three items on the agenda.
zh: 时间快到了，但议程上还有好几项。建议怎么处理。对方说：议程上还有三项。
example: We've only got five minutes left. Shall we cover the most urgent one now and move the others to Thursday?

task: At the end of a client workshop, the client asks what happens next. Explain the next steps with dates.
say: So what happens next?
zh: 客户研讨会结束时，客户问接下来怎么安排。说明后续步骤和时间。对方说：那接下来是什么安排？
example: Next, we'll write up today's notes and send them by Wednesday. Then we'll share a draft design the week after.

task: The project manager asks for help with a weekend cutover. You can help on one day only. Volunteer with a limit.
say: Can anyone help with the weekend cutover?
zh: 项目经理找人帮忙周末切换。你只有一天有空。有条件地主动报名。对方说：有人能帮忙周末的切换吗？
example: I can help on Saturday morning, but I'm not free on Sunday. Would that still be useful?

task: The team can't decide today. Suggest a date to make the decision, so the work isn't blocked.
say: We can't decide on the storage option today.
zh: 团队今天定不下来。建议一个做决定的日期，以免工作被耽误。对方说：存储方案我们今天定不下来。
example: That's fine. Can we agree to make a call by next Friday, so the build isn't held up?

task: You're running the meeting. A colleague says everything is covered. Close the meeting and say what you'll send.
say: I think we've covered everything.
zh: 你是会议主持人。同事说所有事项都讲完了。结束会议，并说明你会发什么。对方说：我觉得都讲完了。
example: Great, thanks, everyone. I'll send round the actions this afternoon. Have a good rest of your day.

task: Someone says 'we' will do something, but it's not clear who. Clarify the owner and offer to take it.
say: Let's get that sorted before go-live.
zh: 有人说“我们”会做某件事，但不清楚具体是谁。明确负责人，并主动接手。对方说：上线前把那个搞定吧。
example: Just to be clear, who's 'we' on this one? I'm happy to own it, but I don't want two people doing the same thing.

task: A colleague who missed part of the meeting asks what was decided on a disputed topic. Sum up the outcome honestly.
say: So where did we land on the database question?
zh: 一位错过部分会议的同事问一个有争议的话题最后怎么定的。如实总结结果。对方说：数据库那个问题最后怎么定的？
example: We didn't fully agree. The plan is to test both options this sprint, and we'll make the final call at the review on the 28th.

task: The chair keeps giving you actions, and you already have too many. Accept one and ask for the other to go to someone else.
say: And Raj, can you take the last two actions as well?
zh: 主持人一直往你身上派任务，你已经太多了。接下一个，请把另一个交给别人。对方说：Raj，最后这两项也交给你吧？
example: I can take one of them. With the migration this week, I don't think I can do both properly. Could someone else pick up the licensing one?

task: A client asks you to put the discussion in writing. Agree and say what the email will include and when.
say: Could you put all that in writing for us?
zh: 客户请你把讨论内容写成书面材料。答应下来，并说明邮件会包括什么、什么时候发。对方说：你能把这些都写下来发给我们吗？
example: Absolutely. I'll send a summary by end of day with the decisions, the actions, and who owns each one.

task: You're the host and the meeting is at time, but someone starts a new topic. Wrap up politely and offer another way to handle it.
say: Oh, and one more thing about the user training...
zh: 你是主持人，会议已经到时间了，但有人又开了一个新话题。礼貌地收尾，并提供别的处理方式。对方说：哦，还有一件关于用户培训的事……
example: That's a good one, but we're right at time. Could you add it to next week's agenda, or flick me an email and I'll follow up?

task: Tom has taken an action, but no date was given. Your work depends on it. Ask him when you'll get an update.
say: Tom's going to look into the network issue.
zh: Tom 接了一项任务，但没给日期。你的工作要靠它。问他什么时候能给你更新。对方说：Tom 会去查网络的问题。
example: Great, thanks, Tom. When do you think you'll have an update? I need to know before I can plan the cutover.

task: A client contact asks what they should tell their boss about a delay. Give them a clear, short message to pass on.
say: What should I tell my manager about the delay?
zh: 客户对接人问他该怎么跟老板说延期的事。给他一个清楚简短、可以直接转达的说法。对方说：延期的事我该怎么跟我经理说？
example: I'd tell her we're about two weeks behind because of the vendor, and we'll confirm a new date by next Monday.

task: At the end of a steering meeting, the chair asks you to read back the decisions and open risks. Be clear and structured.
say: Before we close, can you run through the decisions and the open risks?
zh: 指导委员会会议结束前，主持人请你复述决定事项和未解决的风险。要清楚、有条理。对方说：结束之前，你能过一遍决定事项和未解决的风险吗？
example: Sure. Decisions: we're going with the phased rollout, and the extra budget is approved. Open risks: the vendor's timeline and staff leave over Christmas. I'll circulate the minutes tomorrow.

task: Two teams keep arguing in circles. Suggest taking it offline, and say exactly what you'll do and when you'll report back.
say: I still don't agree with the security team on this.
zh: 两个团队一直在原地争论。建议会后再单独讨论，并说清楚你会做什么、什么时候汇报。对方说：这件事我还是不同意安全团队的看法。
example: I think we'll go round in circles if we keep going today. How about we take it offline? I'll set up half an hour with both teams this week and bring a recommendation back here.

task: The meeting is ending with no owner for an important decision. Push for a name and a date, politely but firmly.
say: Okay, let's all have a think about it.
zh: 会议快结束了，一个重要决定还没有负责人。礼貌而坚定地要求定下负责人和日期。对方说：好吧，大家都再想想。
example: Before we go, can we put a name and a date against that? Otherwise it'll still be open next month. Sarah, would you be happy to own it, with an update by Friday?
